mapper.select: SELECT t1.COMPANY AS company , t1.URL AS url , pa.GR_CD || '_' || pa.SCD || '-' || pa.SNM AS snm , TO_CHAR(t1.CREATED_AT, 'yyyymmddHH24') AS dt , t1.TABLENAME AS tablename , t1.SUBTABLE AS subtable , NVL(t1.SUBTABLE, t1.TABLENAME) AS qtable , COUNT (*) AS req_cnt , COUNT (CASE WHEN t1.REQUEST='0' THEN 1 END) AS wait_cnt , COUNT (CASE WHEN t1.REQUEST='1' THEN 1 END) AS ok_cnt , COUNT (CASE WHEN t1.REQUEST='2' THEN 1 END) AS err_cnt FROM API_Q t1 , API_PARAMS pa WHERE t1.UPDATED_AT >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND pa.URL = t1.URL GROUP BY t1.COMPANY , t1.URL , pa.GR_CD || '_' || pa.SCD || '-' || pa.SNM , TO_CHAR(t1.CREATED_AT, 'yyyymmddHH24') , t1.TABLENAME , t1.SUBTABLE ORDER BY t1.COMPANY ASC, snm ASC, dt DESC

SELECT t1.COMPANY AS company , SUBSTR (t1.URL, INSTR (t1.URL,'/',-1) + 1) AS url , t1.HEADERS AS headers , t1.QUERYPARAMS AS queryparams , t1.TABLENAME AS tablename , t1.SUBTABLE AS subtable , t1.REQUEST AS request , t1.STATUS AS status , t1.STATUSTEXT AS statustext , t1.MSG_CD AS msg_cd , t1.MSG1 AS msg1 , t1.ERRCODE AS errcode , t1.API_KEY AS api_key , t1.KEY_VALUE AS key_value , t1.SUB_KEY_VALUE AS sub_key_value , t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , CASE WHEN t1.TABLENAME = 'API_KSE_INFO' THEN t1.MSG1 ELSE t1.KEY1 END AS key1 , t1.KEY2 AS key2 , t1.NUM1 AS num1 FROM API_Q t1 WHERE F_API_KEY(t1.TABLENAME, t1.SUBTABLE, t1.API_KEY) = 'Y' AND t1.COMPANY = #{company} AND t1.URL = #{url} AND TO_CHAR(t1.CREATED_AT, 'yyyymmddHH24') = #{dt} ORDER BY t1.HEADERS , t1.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT t1.API_KEY AS api_key , t1.HEADERS AS headers , TO_CHAR(t1.CREATED_AT, 'MM.DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at , t1.MSG_CD AS msg_cd , t1.MSG1 AS msg1 , 0 AS cur_row , 0 AS all_row FROM API_Q t1 WHERE t1.API_KEY = #{apiKey}

SELECT t1.column_id AS column_id , t1.column_name AS column_name , t2.comments AS comments , ' ' AS col_val FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS t1 , USER_COL_COMMENTS t2 WHERE t1.table_name = UPPER(#{tableName}) AND t1.column_name <> 'API_KEY' AND t2.table_name = t1.table_name AND t2.column_name = t1.column_name ORDER BY t1.column_id ASC
